events.name: Cleveland Guardians at Chicago White Sox

headlines.description: - Jo Adell and Jose Ramirez powered Cleveland with a pair of two-out triples, and the Guardians avoided an AL Division Series sweep by cooling off the Chicago White Sox with a 9-3 victory in Game 3 on Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jo Adell and Jose Ramirez star as the Guardians beat the White Sox 9-3 to avoid elimination

events.name: Los Angeles Dodgers at Atlanta Braves

headlines.description: — Andy Pages drove in two runs with a bases-loaded single in the seventh inning to give Los Angeles the lead, and the Dodgers beat the Atlanta Braves 4-1 on Wednesday night to clinch their NL Division Series.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pages delivers go-ahead single in 7th as Dodgers beat Braves 4-1 to clinch NL Division Series
